an3.124:1.1: yassaṃ bhikkhave disāyaṃ bhikkhū bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti manasikātuṃpi me esā bhikkhave disā na phāsu hoti pageva gantuṃ
an3.124:1.3: addhā te āyasmanto tayo dhamme pajahiṃsu tayo dhamme bahulīmakaṃsu
an3.124:1.10: yassaṃ bhikkhave disāyaṃ bhikkhū bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti manasikātuṃpi me esā bhikkhave disā na phāsu hoti pageva gantuṃ
an3.124:1.12: addhā te āyasmanto ime tayo dhamme pajahiṃsu ime tayo dhamme bahulīmakaṃsu.
